metadata.title: Ibikomoka ku Bimera n'Ibindi by'Umwimerere i Musanze
metadata.description: Imbaraga z'Igisura itanga ibikomoka ku bimera n'ibindi by'umwimerere i Musanze, mu Rwanda, hafi ya Gare ya Musanze. Dufite uburambe bw'imyaka irenga {years}. Duhamagare cyangwa utwandikire kuri WhatsApp.

common.whatsappMessage: Muraho {name}, nifuzaga amakuru ku byo mucuruza.

hero.title: Ibintu by'umwimerere. Imyaka irenga {years} y'icyizere.
hero.description: Menya ibikomoka ku bimera n'ibindi by'umwimerere ducuruza, kandi utuvugishe ako kanya kuri WhatsApp cyangwa kuri telefoni. Twishimiye kugufasha kubona icyo ukeneye.

products.title: Menya ibyo ducuruza
products.description: Reba ibikomoka ku bimera n'ibindi by'umwimerere ducuruza.
products.emptyDescription: Amakuru kuri buri kintu, ingano n'ibiciro bizashyirwa hano. Hagati aho, twandikire tukubwire ibihari.

why.title: Kuki wahitamo Imbaraga z'Igisura?
why.experienceText: Tumaze imyaka irenga {years} ducuruza ibikomoka ku bimera n'ibindi by'umwimerere.
why.naturalText: Ibikomoka ku bimera n'ibindi by'umwimerere, buri kimwe gifite amakuru asobanutse.
why.personalText: Uvugana natwe ubwacu. Dufata umwanya wo gusubiza ibibazo byawe ku byo ducuruza.
why.visitText: Ngwino ku iduka ryacu tuganire imbonankubone.

order.title: Uko wabona ibyo ducuruza
order.step1Text: Reba ibyo ducuruza hano, cyangwa utubaze ibihari.
order.step2Text: Twandikire kuri WhatsApp cyangwa uduhamagare. Tuzasubiza ibibazo byawe kandi twemeze ibyo utumije.
order.step3Text: Fata ibyo watumije ku iduka ryacu i Musanze, cyangwa utubaze niba bishobora kukoherezwa.
order.deliveryText: Bitewe n'aho uherereye n'ingano y'ibyo watumije, bishobora koherezwa mu modoka zitwara abagenzi ziva i Musanze zijya i Kigali cyangwa ahandi. Ni wowe wifatira ipaki igihe igeze.
order.deliveryNote: Banza utwandikire tumenye niba bishoboka aho uri. Uburyo bwo kohereza, igihe n'ikiguzi tubyumvikanaho nawe.

info.title: Menya neza icyo ugura
info.description: Buri kintu kizagira paji igaragaza amakuru ahari kuri cyo, kugira ngo uhitemo ufite amakuru ahagije.
info.name: Izina

about.title: Umuryango utanga ibintu by'umwimerere i Musanze
about.text1: Imbaraga z'Igisura itanga ibikomoka ku bimera n'ibindi by'umwimerere i Musanze, mu Rwanda.
about.text2: Mu myaka irenga {years}, twiyemeje gufasha buri mukiriya gusobanukirwa n'ibyo tumuha: icyo ari cyo n'uko yabikoresha.

contact.title: Ufite ikibazo?
contact.description: Tuvugishe ako kanya, tugufashe kubona amakuru ukeneye.

location.title: Aho turi n'amasaha y'akazi
location.directionsNote: Ikarita igaragaza Gare ya Musanze. Iduka ryacu riri hafi yayo.

final.title: Wifuza kumenya byinshi?
final.description: Reba ibyo ducuruza cyangwa uvugane na {name} ako kanya.

about.metaDescription: Imbaraga z'Igisura: ibikomoka ku bimera n'ibindi by'umwimerere i Musanze, mu Rwanda, dufite uburambe bw'imyaka irenga {years}.

errors.notAuthorized: Iyi konti nta burenganzira ifite bwo kwinjira mu biro.

dashboard.title: Ibiro
dashboard.intro: Cunga ibyo ducuruza n'ibyiciro bigaragara ku rubuga.
dashboard.howTo1: Fungura Ibyo ducuruza uhitemo ikiri gutegurwa, cyangwa ukore ikintu gishya.
dashboard.howTo2: Andika izina n'amakuru mu Kinyarwanda no mu Cyongereza (ururimi rumwe rurahagije ku giri gutegurwa).
dashboard.howTo3: Ongeramo amafoto nyakuri, hanyuma ingano n'ibiciro niba byemejwe.
dashboard.howTo4: Shyira uko gihagaze kuri Cyashyizwe ahagaragara hanyuma ubike. Kigaragara ku rubuga mu minota mike.

productForm.createIntro: Tangira n'izina. Amafoto, ingano n'ibiciro uzabyongeramo ku rupapuro rukurikira.
productForm.translationsHint: Uzuza indimi zombi igihe bishoboka. Igiri gutegurwa gishobora kubikwa n'ururimi rumwe; urubuga rugaragaza urundi rurimi kugeza gihinduwe.
productForm.name: Izina
productForm.shortDescriptionHelp: Interuro imwe cyangwa ebyiri zigaragara ku ikarita y'ikintu.
productForm.traditionalUseHelp: Uko bikunze gukoreshwa. Andika amakuru uzi neza gusa.
productForm.statusHelp: Ibyashyizwe ahagaragara ni byo byonyine bigaragara ku rubuga.
productForm.availabilityHelp: Bireke kuri "Ntibigaragazwe" keretse ubihindura buri gihe.
productForm.deleteText: Bisiba burundu iki kintu, ingano zacyo n'amafoto yacyo. Kugira ngo ugihishe by'agateganyo, shyira uko gihagaze kuri Kiri gutegurwa cyangwa Cyabitswe.
productForm.deleteConfirm: Gusiba burundu iki kintu n'amafoto yacyo yose?

variants.title: Ingano n'ibiciro
variants.intro: Umurongo umwe kuri buri ngano. Siga igiciro ubusa niba gitangwa ubajijwe; ntikigaragazwa nka 0.
variants.label: Izina ry'ingano (si ngombwa)
variants.empty: Nta ngano zirashyirwamo. Urubuga rugaragaza "Baza igiciro".

images.title: Amafoto
images.intro: Koresha amafoto nyakuri gusa. JPG, PNG, WebP cyangwa AVIF. Amafoto manini ya telefoni agabanywa ubwayo mbere yo koherezwa.

categories.intro: Kora, hindura amazina kandi utondeke ibyiciro abakiriya bakoresha bashakisha. Ibyiciro bifite ibintu byashyizwe ahagaragara ni byo bigaragara ku rubuga.

aiDraft.title: Ubufasha bwa AI
aiDraft.intro: AI ishobora kwandika umushinga mu dusanduku turimo ubusa hepfo, mu ndimi zombi: ibisobanuro, uko bikunze gukoreshwa, uburyo bwiza bwo kubikoresha, aho bikomoka n'uko bibikwa. Ntishyiramo ibiciro, amafoto cyangwa ibyo kwitondera.
aiDraft.reviewNote: Soma kandi ukosore byose mbere yo gukanda Bika. Reba neza Ikinyarwanda.
aiDraft.filled: AI yujuje {count, plural, one {agasanduku #} other {udusanduku #}} (twagaragajwe n'ibara ry'umuhondo). Dusome, ukosore, hanyuma ukande Bika.
aiDraft.nothingToFill: Udusanduku twose turimo inyandiko. Siba ibiri mu gasanduku niba ushaka ko AI ikandika.
aiDraft.failed: AI ntiyashoboye kwandika ubu. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.

products.metaDescription: Ibirungo, amavuta akomoka ku bimera, ubunyobwa, inzuzi, icyayi n'ibindi by'umwimerere bya Imbaraga z'Igisura i Musanze, mu Rwanda.
products.title: Ibintu by'umwimerere
products.intro: Ibirungo, amavuta akomoka ku bimera, ubunyobwa, inzuzi, icyayi n'ibindi. Ibiciro n'ingano bigaragazwa iyo byemejwe. Ku bindi byose, tubaze kuri WhatsApp.
products.searchPlaceholder: Shakisha mu Kinyarwanda cyangwa mu Cyongereza
products.emptyText: Amakuru ari gushyirwaho. Hagati aho, tubaze kuri WhatsApp cyangwa uduhamagare tukubwire ibihari.
products.noResultsText: Gerageza irindi jambo, reba uko wanditse, cyangwa uhitemo ikindi cyiciro. Ushobora no kutubaza ako kanya.
products.errorText: Reba niba murandasi ikora, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
products.helpText: Mu iduka dufite ibindi byinshi kurusha ibiri hano. Twandikire tukubwire ibihari.

productPage.askText: Twandikire kuri WhatsApp. Izina n'umurongo w'iyi paji byongerwamo ubwabyo.
productPage.translationNote: Amakuru y'iki kintu ntaraboneka mu Kinyarwanda.

orderList.title: Urutonde rwanjye
orderList.intro: Hitamo ibyo ushaka n'umubare wabyo, hanyuma utwoherereze urutonde kuri WhatsApp. Ibiciro n'uko biboneka tubyemeranya aho. Nta kwishyura bikorerwa kuri uru rubuga.
orderList.emptyText: Ongeraho ibyo ushaka uvuye mu byo ducuruza, hanyuma utwoherereze urutonde kuri WhatsApp mu butumwa bumwe.
orderList.totalNote: Ibiciro n'uko biboneka tubyemeza nawe kuri WhatsApp.
orderList.someOnRequest: Ibiciro bimwe bibazwa; tuzakubwira igiteranyo kuri WhatsApp.
orderList.notePlaceholder: Urugero: nzaza ku iduka ku wa Gatandatu
orderList.sendHelp: WhatsApp irafunguka urutonde rwawe rwanditswe. Rusuzume, hanyuma ukande ohereza.
